Key points.
What a claims adjuster does. Investigates, verifies coverage, estimates damage, and recommends payment.

In depth.
The adjuster inspects, interviews, and reviews your documentation against the policy. Cooperate fully but know your rights — including hiring your own public adjuster on large losses. Educational content only — not financial advice. Consult a licensed insurance professional for your situation.
